name: Ghost Chat Application
description: A haunted chatbot experience where users communicate with spirits from beyond

modules.name: ChatBotModule
responsibilities: Handle different types of user intents
Provide fallback responses for unknown queries

constructor.description: Initialize the ghost's brain with response templates and state

processMessage.description: Main entry point for handling user messages

generateResponse.description: Create a spooky response based on parsed intent

parameters.name: parsedMessage
parameters.description: Parsed message with intent and keywords

canRespond.description: Check if the ghost understands the message

returns.description: True if ghost can respond meaningfully

extensibility: Add personality traits (friendly ghost, scary ghost, wise ghost)
Add machine learning for better responses
Add emotion detection and appropriate responses
Implement context-aware responses based on previous messages
implementation_notes: Start with simple keyword-based responses
Use a response template system with placeholders
Add random variation to responses for natural feel
Include spooky vocabulary and ghost-themed language
Handle edge cases like empty messages or very long input

modules.name: UIController
responsibilities: Render messages in the chat window
Handle user input from the text field

constructor.description: Bind to DOM elements and set up event listeners

displayMessage.description: Add a message to the chat window

clearChat.description: Remove all messages from the chat window

scrollToBottom.description: Scroll to show the latest message

implementation_notes: Use CSS animations for smooth transitions
Ensure accessibility (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation)
Handle long messages with proper wrapping
Add fade-in animations for new messages
Use spooky fonts and colors consistently

modules.name: MessageParser

constructor.description: Initialize parsing rules and keyword dictionaries

parse.description: Break down message into analyzable components

returns.description: Parsed message with tokens, intent, keywords

detectKeywords.description: Find important words in the message

implementation_notes: Use regex for basic pattern matching
Create keyword dictionaries for common intents
Handle typos and variations gracefully
Escape HTML to prevent XSS attacks
Consider using a library like DOMPurify for sanitization

modules.name: Theming
extensibility: Create seasonal themes (Halloween, Day of the Dead)
Implement CSS custom properties for easy theming
implementation_notes: Use CSS variables for easy theme switching
Ensure sufficient contrast for readability
Test on multiple screen sizes
Add prefers-reduced-motion support
Keep animations subtle to avoid distraction

flow: ChatBotModule uses MessageParser to analyze message

future_features: Voice input/output for hands-free ghost communication
Multiple ghost personalities to chat with
Easter eggs and hidden ghost responses
Integration with external APIs for weather, time, etc.

kiro_expansion_guide.phase_1: Implement basic keyword matching and simple responses
kiro_expansion_guide.phase_2: Add UI animations and typing indicators
kiro_expansion_guide.phase_3: Enhance parser with better intent detection
